name: Increlex
indications_original: INCRELEX (mecasermin) injection is indicated for the treatment of growth failure in pediatric patients 2 years of age and older with severe primary IGF- 1 deficiency or with growth hormone (GH) gene deletion who have developed neutralizing antibodies to GH. ( 1 ) Limitations of use: INCRELEX is not a substitute to GH for approved GH indications.
contraindications_original: INCRELEX should be administered subcutaneously. ( 2.2 ) Injection sites should be rotated to avoid lipohypertrophy. ( 2.2 ) Recommended starting dosage: 0.04 mg/kg to 0.08 mg/kg twice daily. If well-tolerated for at least one week, the dose may be increased by 0.04 mg/kg per dose, to the maximum dose of 0.12 mg/kg given twice daily. ( 2.1 )
adverseReactions_original: Known Hypersensitivity to mecasermin ( 4 ) Closed Epiphyses ( 4 ) Malignant Neoplasia ( 4 )
